opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn round

amount.raw: Maximum grant £20,000 (New Projects, Acquisitions, Long-Term Research); £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures, Publications); £2,500 (Research and Travel)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) for New Projects, Acquisitions, Conferences, Lectures, Publications, Long‑Term Research; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exhibitions, catalogues, commissions, acquisitions, collections, conferences, publications and long‑term research related to sculpture.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000 (travel and subsistence); accommodation provided.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Institute fellowships); researchers focusing on Henry Moore (Studios & Gardens fellowships); artists for Artist Research Fellowships; senior scholars for Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: One‑month fellowships providing accommodation, travel and subsistence to support research on sculpture using the Institute’s library, archive and collections.
